claim: Patchline ships an incident survival analysis estimating time-to-next-incident hazard ratios for adopters. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the survival analysis claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make incident-survival-analysis-gate`.
